description: Personal mixed-timeline reader for RSS and RSSHub, in pure Go with native UI (MyGo). Desktop app and headless server in one program.
notes: Oriel keeps its database, logs and client settings in %AppData%\Oriel, outside the Scoop directory, so uninstalling the app does not remove your reading data.
This is both the desktop app and a headless server: run 'oriel serve -data <dir> -port 7470' for the server mode.
The server password is read only from the ORIEL_PASSWORD environment variable, never from a command line flag.
The Windows installers are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn if you run them directly.
